page.overview:
Who is Zirnberk Fyrgeissyn?

Zirnberk Fyrgeissyn is a non-player character in Final Fantasy XIV. He is an antagonist in the level 50–60 blue mage questline and the eldest son of Fyrgeiss Loetkilbsyn.

Zirnberk is the commander of the Stone Torches who serve as Amajina & Sons Mineral Concern's private security force. He fights under the name Siegfried in the colosseum, garnering attention from many fans.

Zirnberk triumphed against Ultros in the Celestium, making his Masked Carnivale debut. Afterward he challenged Martyn to a duel. Following the bout, he was introduced by his father, and met those of the Blue Mage Guild with a proper greeting. His father revealed how the Masked Carnivale would show the skills of the Stone Torches and bring in fresh recruits and gil, saying blue magic was a bunch of parlor tricks and brushed it off.

Zirnberk along with his father and another Stone Torch were in the mines using voidsent to quell the hecatoncheir uprising and a few escaped aboveground. The three gave chase only to find that those from the Blue Mage Guild had slayed the beasts. After Fyrgeiss was questioned by Martyn and Royse, he stated that the colosseum was his, especially with how much he invested in it, and threatened to drive the guild and Royse out of Eorzea. Martyn made a wager on Royse's behalf that if he won against Zirnberk, the Celestium and the beasts in its employ would stay with Royse, and if he lost, all of the Celestium's assets would go to Fyrgeiss.
